3.  24-55751  Recommendation to receive and file updates from the Mayor’s Fund and Policy
  Subcommittee and the Continuum of Care (CoC) HSAC representative.

  Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  • The Mayor’s Fund had an ending balance of $149,309.88 for the month of
  September, with total contributions amounting to $1,344.53.
  • The subcommittee has completed the Standard Operating Procedures and
  will present them at the January Committee meeting for final approval.
  Policy Subcommittee
  • The committee continues to look at the impact of new policies.
  • There is a continued discussing on clean sweeps policy and the possibility of
  diverting those resources to providing more permanent storage or cleaning
  resources at encampment sites.
  • The subcommittee discussed the potential visit to MHALA. Staff have
  connected MHALA leadership with Chair Sarah and are currently in the
  process of scheduling a meeting.
  CoC Updates
  • Member Kimberly Lewis advised the committee that there was no meeting
  for the month of November the next scheduled meeting will be in December.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Bedy, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Lewis, Rew, Lie, Russell, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Howat, Killion, Hilliard

4.  24-55752  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund application for Disabled Resources
  Center Inc. for $10,000.

  • Member Rew advised the committee that Disabled Resources Center Inc.
  attended the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee meeting via zoom and provided a
  summary of their current projects. The subcommittee moved to approve the

5.  24-55753  Recommendation to receive and file the Homeless Services Bureau Staff
  Operations and Updates Report by Paul Duncan from the Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Lewis, Rew, Lie, Russell, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Howat, Killion, Hilliard

  • Dalton Dorr from the Health Department provided a quarterly operations data
  report for the Multi-Service Center, Mobile Access Center and Outreach
  covering the months of July, August, and September.
  • There was discussion around the impact of increasing services outside of the
  MSC.
  • Based on the data provided, committee members raised questions regarding
  mental health and inquired about the possibility of receiving the data in a
  different format to better analyze overlapping services.
  • The committee also asked for a clearer explanation of what the data
  numbers represent to staff and how these numbers help identify areas where
  additional services are needed.
  • Paul Duncan Homeless Services Bureau Manager provided staffing
  updates.
  • The office of Homeless Strategies and Partnership hosted a community
  engagement session around Prop 1 proposals that would be on City land.
  • A community mural will be painted at the MSC during the month of
  December.
  • Staff informed the committee that the City Auditor’s audit is nearing
  completion. The audit examined several programs, including part of the CoC
